revisions.change: Retired the chain-wide latest-pairs request from the restart-backfill source set and moved sweep completeness to required-source accounting.
revisions.evidence: The provider API reference documents /latest/dex/pairs/{chainId}/{pairId} as a pair-specific lookup with a required pair identifier and documents no chain-wide latest-pairs endpoint; every preserved sweep (31 of 31 in the runs tree, a superset of the 19 audited) failed the request deterministically with HTTP_STATUS_NON_2XX and it never returned a single pair, so retirement removes no realized coverage.
